patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark blue backgrounds and white backgrounds, creating clear visual separation and hierarchy.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, often in all caps or title case, contrasted with smaller, highly readable body text.
A deep, authoritative dark blue (#212830, #00477d) serves as the primary brand color, providing a strong backdrop for white text and bright accent blue (#3371e6) for calls to action.
The header navigation transforms on scroll, shrinking in height, gaining a solid dark background, and removing secondary elements like social links, while remaining sticky at the top.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content, creating depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is frequently presented in a two-column layout within sections, often pairing a large quote or descriptive text on one side with a supporting image or list on the other.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height, changes its background color from transparent to solid, and hides certain elements (like social icons) using CSS transitions triggered by scroll position.
Create a hero section where a background image is fixed or scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, achieving a parallax scrolling effect.

Utilize CSS keyframes to animate elements into view as they enter the viewport, such as fade-up or slide-in effects for section titles, cards, and other content blocks, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, impactful headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by highly legible body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp edges for layout blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between sections, creating an airy feel, while content within sections maintains a comfortable reading rhythm.

standout: The site's design stands out through its authoritative and serious tone, effectively conveyed by the strong, deep color palette and bold typography. The seamless integration of a prominent donation call-to-action throughout the site, without feeling intrusive, is also distinctive.
